sentences.en: The maid arranged the knives and forks on the table.
sentences.zh: 女仆把刀叉摆放在餐桌上。

sentences.en: The boy can handle a knife and fork very well.
sentences.zh: 这个男孩用刀叉吃饭很熟练。

sentences.en: Do you eat spaghetti by twirling it around your fork?
sentences.zh: 你是用叉子卷起意大利面吃吗？

senses.zh: 餐叉耙子，叉(道路或河流的)分岔处
